# Gigahost Provider

Manage resources on gigahost.no, a Norwegian hosting provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The `terraform {}` block is recognised by both OpenTofu and
# Terraform. OpenTofu additionally supports an `opentofu {}` alias if
# you prefer a cleaner tool-specific declaration.
terraform {
  required_providers {
    gigahost = {
      source  = "kradalby/gigahost"
      version = "~> 0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "gigahost" {
  # Recommended: set GIGAHOST_TOKEN env var instead of passing the
  # token through a variable.
  token = var.gigahost_token
}

variable "gigahost_token" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Gigahost API bearer token."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Override the API base URL (defaults to https://api.gigahost.no/api/v0).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Account password. May also be supplied via the `GIGAHOST_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API bearer token. May also be supplied via the `GIGAHOST_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Account email. May also be supplied via the `GIGAHOST_USERNAME` environment variable.
